33:63.text: People ask you concerning the Hour, say: "The knowledge of it is with Allâh only. What do you know? It may be that the Hour is near!"

33:64.text: Verily, Allâh has cursed the disbelievers, and has prepared for them a flaming Fire

33:65.text: Wherein they will abide for ever, and they will find neither a Walî

33:66.text: On the Day when their faces will be turned over in the Fire, they will say: "Oh, would that we had obeyed Allâh and obeyed the Messenger

33:67.text: And they will say: "Our Lord! Verily, we obeyed our chiefs and our great ones, and they misled us from the

33:68.text: "Our Lord! Give them double torment and curse them with a mighty curse!"

33:69.text: O you who believe! Be not like those who annoyed Mûsa
, but Allâh cleared him of that which they alleged, and he was honourable before Allâh.

33:70.text: O you who believe! Keep your duty to Allâh and fear Him, and speak

33:71.text: He will direct you to do righteous good deeds and will forgive you your sins. And whosoever obeys Allâh and His Messenger
, he has indeed achieved a great achievement
(i.e. he will be saved from the Hell-fire and will be admitted to Paradise)

33:72.text: (the trust or moral responsibility or honesty and all the duties which Allâh has ordained)
to the heavens and the earth, and the mountains, but they declined to bear it and were afraid of it
. But man bore it. Verily, he was unjust

33:73.text: So that Allâh will punish the hypocrites, men and women, and the men and women who are Al-Mushrikûn
(polytheists, idolaters, pagans, disbelievers, in the Oneness of Allâh, and His Messenger Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)
the true believers of the Islâmic Monotheism, men and women. And Allâh is Ever Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
